import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    P = [[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            P[i][j] = int(next(it))
    
    # G: map from integer (bitset of subsets) to value (mod MOD)
    G = {1: 1}  # only subset 0 (empty set) present
    
    for i in range(N):
        # convert G to H: map from tuple of present subsets to value
        H = {}
        for bitset, val in G.items():
            S = []
            for m in range(1 << N):
                if (bitset >> m) & 1:
                    S.append(m)
            H[tuple(S)] = val
        G.clear()
        
        for j in range(1 << N):
            # compute pst = product over k of (P[i][k] if j has bit k else 100-P[i][k])
            pst = 1
            for k in range(N):
                if (j >> k) & 1:
                    pst = (pst * P[i][k]) % MOD
                else:
                    pst = (pst * (100 - P[i][k])) % MOD
            if pst == 0:
                continue
            
            for S, val in H.items():
                ans = 0
                for l in range(N):
                    if (j >> l) & 1:
                        for m in S:
                            if not ((m >> l) & 1):
                                new_subset = m | (1 << l)
                                ans |= 1 << new_subset
                if ans != 0:
                    G[ans] = (G.get(ans, 0) + val * pst) % MOD
    
    total = sum(G.values()) % MOD
    # divide by 100^(N*N)
    inv = pow(100, MOD - 1 - N*N, MOD)  # modular inverse of 100^(N*N)
    ans = (total * inv) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
